 Search November 2026 K-Pop Comebacks: The Releases Fans Can't Afford to Miss
 lewishooper1 9 minutes ago 3 min read From highly anticipated group returns to exciting solo releases, November is bringing another wave of new music to K-pop, as some of the industry's biggest names compete for chart success, fan attention, and the next global hit. 
  November 2026 is bringing another month of K-pop releases. Which artists will dominate fans' playlists? Now that 2026 is coming to an end, the K-pop industry is starting to show no signs of slowing down. In fact, it is quite the opposite, with many K-pop artists cramming in last-minute concerts, dropping last-minute albums, and some even appearing in dramas! 
 This time of year, however, does often see awesome new music from some artists who have been away from the spotlight for a while. From established chart-topping groups to rising stars, artists are preparing to make their mark before the year-end award season gets underway. 
 NCT DREAM : Another Chapter for the K-pop Powerhouse 
 November 2026 sees another chapter from NCT Dream, as they are preparing for their return to the K-pop stage on November 9th with a brand new full-length album titled DREAM AFTER DREAM . 
 NCT Dream Dream After Dream concept photo. (SM Entertainment) This brand new album gives fans yet another opportunity to see how the group continues to evolve musically year after year. With an established international fanbase already and a strong history of album sales, their comeback will be one of November's major releases to watch, and one that the Dojeon Media team cannot wait to see drop. Could NCT Dream have a Christmas number one on the way as well? 
 ATEEZ:  Keeping the Momentum Going 
 ATEEZ really have kept the momentum going recently, by dropping trending dance moves on social media that took literally global audiences to copy the routines, as well as appearing on international talk shows, music awards and appearing as special guests. 
 For ATEEZ, knowing when to cash in on appearances is key. November 13th will see ATEEZ drop their new album series GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6 , which continues their popular album series and brings another chapter of their distinctive musical identity to fans. 
 It is no secret that the high-energy performances from ATEEZ have put them on the global music map, and with this new music drop, their momentum is still increasing year on year. Don't forget to mark your calendars for November 13th! 
 TOMORROW X TOGETHER:  The Next Big Release 
 The next big release we have to look forward to this November is from TOMORROW X TOGETHER (TXT) , with their ninth mini album release titled PERFECT STORM , on November 16th. TXT are already high-profile artists who have had countless musical successes in the past. With their already established international fanbase, this November could see them build on their creative concepts and perhaps put a spin on their musical direction. Mark your calendars for November 16th ! 
 ENHYPEN  and Nayeon:  November's Solo and Group Highlights 
 ENHYPEN is also preparing a new musical release this month on November 20th. The new release titled THE SIN : PARALLEL WORLD  and TWICE member Nayeon will return as well with her new solo single "NA-sty"  (her first since 2024) following a break from TWICE . 
 The Dojeon Media team is hoping to see a more playful side of Nayeon both in her personality and musically. These two very different types of music styles are ones that we cannot wait to listen to! 
 Fan Opinion: Which Comeback Are Fans Most Excited About? 
 With lots of new music coming out this November, K-pop fans are spoilt. Global K-pop communities have been raving online about the new concept theories and ideas, with some even trying to work out what choreography styles some of the groups may go for. 
 We are sure that some of these new moves and meaningful lyrics will find their way onto social media trends. Which new releases will go head to head this November? K-pop fans can all but wait to find out. 
 Final Thoughts 
 For Dojeon Media, November 2026 is already proving to be a pivotal time in the K-pop calendar. From established groups who have made household names to trainees to comebacks, these artists are all competing for attention and to achieve number one on the music charts this month. 
 Whether it's NCT DREAM, ATEEZ, TXT, ENHYPEN, or Nayeon, the coming weeks will offer plenty for fans to look forward to as the industry heads towards the end of another busy year, perhaps more than the last one. 
 Dojeon Fam, which November comeback are you looking forward to the most? Drop your comments below!
